title: golden gui
description: A sleek, golden luxury GUI pack.
body: Transform your Minecraft interface with Golden GUI! This resource pack replaces the classic, dull grey menus and buttons with a stunning, high-quality golden theme. Every button, container, and UI element has been carefully crafted to give your game a luxurious and polished look. It is fully compatible with modern Minecraft versions and looks amazing in any biome. Perfect for players who want to add a touch of elegance to their survival or creative worlds. Download now and experience Minecraft in pure gold!
